==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=RavenDB&min=RavenDB&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/RavenDBTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=RavenDB&min=RavenDB&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using Raven.Client.Documents;
using Raven.Embedded;

// Verify.RavenDB: Verifies a RavenDB IDocumentSession, writing every pending change in that session to the snapshot.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.RavenDB
// Note: Verifying an IDocumentSession writes its pending changes: documents added, and the field
// name with the old and new value for each change.
// Note: VerifyRavenDB exposes only Initialize(): there are no settings methods, scrubbers or
// recording.
// Note: The shipped package depends only on RavenDB.Client; RavenDB.Embedded is for tests.
// Note: No licence key is needed for the embedded community server.
// Note: The package targets net9.0 only.
// Note: This is the RavenDB counterpart to Verify.EntityFramework's ChangeTracker snapshots, and
// the two do not overlap.
public class RavenDBTests
{
    // Verifying the session snapshots what it is about to send: the document key and a
    // DocumentAdded change carrying the new value. Nothing is saved, so no cleanup is needed.
    // Not run by default: downloads and starts an embedded RavenDB server the first time it runs.
    [Fact(Skip = "downloads and starts an embedded RavenDB server the first time it runs.")]
    public async Task AddDocument()
    {
        using var session = store.Value.OpenSession();
        var person = new RavenPerson
        {
            Name = "John"
        };
        session.Store(person);
        await Verify(session);
    }

    static readonly Lazy<IDocumentStore> store = new(StartServer);

    // The embedded server is downloaded on first use and started against a temp directory,
    // which is why the samples are skipped by default.
    static IDocumentStore StartServer()
    {
        EmbeddedServer.Instance.StartServer();
        return EmbeddedServer.Instance.GetDocumentStore("Samples");
    }
}


==== packages

Verify.XunitV3
xunit.v3

RavenDB.Embedded

==== interactions

Warning external-tool: RavenDB needs RavenDB embedded server: RavenDB.Embedded downloads a RavenDB server on first use and starts it against a temporary data directory, so the tests need network access and a machine that can run it.
